name: load_structure
description: Loads a biomolecular structure file into the 3D viewer. Accepts a structure file (.cif, .mmcif, .pdb) saved in the conversation's artifact directory, given as a path relative to it (e.g. "4HHB/pdb_00004hhb.cif", "P00533/AF-P00533-F1-model_v6.cif") or an artifact filename. Files elsewhere (e.g. in the user's workspace) are NOT loaded: copy them into the conversation's artifact directory first. Database IDs (PDB, AlphaFold, UniProt) and URLs are NOT accepted: download the file first (with the pdb-database or alphafold-database-fetch-and-analyze skill, or e.g. curl for other URLs), then load its path.

id.description: Path to a local structure file (e.g. "4HHB/pdb_00004hhb.cif", "data/model.pdb") or an artifact filename, in the conversation's artifact directory. Not a database ID, URL, or workspace path.

source.description: Optional explicit structure source. Auto-detected from id if omitted.
